title: Whole-home audio

roles.label: Sonos Amp

quantity.verify: one amplifier per 4 passive speakers and at least one per room (per 8 speakers on a commercial 70V line)

roles.capability: Streams and powers the speakers, controlled from the Sonos app: one Sonos Amp per 4 passive speakers, new or existing (Henry, 2026-10-12; exactly that count on 39 of 75 Livewire quotes with Sonos Amps and architectural speakers, within one on 53), and at least one per room with speakers (Henry, 2026-10-27: one per room on 11 of 25 accepted or presented multi-room quotes with 2 or more speaker pairs, one per 4 speakers on 7; D-Tools 2024-2026). Commercial jobs get a JBL Professional CSA180Z (1 x 80W, 70V/100V), one per 8 speakers on the 70V line

roles.label: Sonos Amp Multi
roles.capability: Eight-channel (8 x 125 W) streaming amplifier for up to 4 stereo zones in one rack unit, when the request names it (Henry, 2026-10-27: on 3 accepted or presented Livewire quotes, 32563, 31909 and 31871, D-Tools 2024-2026)

roles.label: Sonos Amp Multi rack mount (2U)
roles.capability: Rack-mounts the Amp Multi (on 2 of the 3 Livewire quotes with one)

roles.label: Sonos In-Ceiling speakers (pair)

quantity.verify: one pair of in-ceiling speakers per indoor zone

roles.capability: In-ceiling architectural speakers by Sonance, one pair per room

roles.label: Sonos Outdoor speakers (pair)

quantity.verify: outdoor areas to cover, one pair each

roles.capability: Weather-resistant architectural speakers by Sonance for outdoor living areas

roles.label: Sonos Port
roles.capability: Adds Sonos streaming to an existing stereo, receiver, turntable or CD player (Henry, 2026-10-28: a CD player gets a Sonos Port)

roles.label: CD player
roles.capability: A CD player the client buys from us; Livewire has no standard model (one Onkyo DX-C390 and one Yamaha CD-C603BL on past quotes), so it is priced in the final proposal. Its Sonos Port streams it (Zack's Paulenich job, 2026-10-30).

roles.label: Episode in-wall volume control

quantity.verify: one per room that needs local volume

roles.capability: Local volume for that room's speakers

labor.basis: Livewire packages since 2025: Sonos Amp Package 0.5 hours, SONOS by Sonance In-Ceiling Speakers package 2.9 hours per pair (retrofit with wire); so each amp and Port carries 0.5 hours and each speaker pair 3 hours, plus 1 hour of setup: 8 hours for a typical two-zone job; a Sonos Amp about 1 hour (backtest of 9 accepted amp-only jobs, median 1.2 h)

assumptions: Speakers are retrofit into accessible ceilings with new speaker wire to the equipment location.
A working Wi-Fi network covers the equipment location; Sonos is controlled from the Sonos app.
Quantities marked as minimums are confirmed during a site visit.
exclusions: Televisions, soundbars and home theater (quoted separately).
